description: Generate a standards-compliant iCalendar (.ics, RFC 5545) file from JSON events — ready for Google Calendar, Outlook and Apple Calendar invites or "add to calendar" links. Time zones with a generated VTIMEZONE (DST rules from the IANA database), all-day and multi-day events, recurrence (RRULE validated, EXDATE), reminders (VALARM), organizer / attendees with RSVP, location, URL, geo, categories and status. Proper escaping and 75-octet line folding; deterministic UIDs. Returns the .ics text and a data: URI. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/ics-generate

events.description: Events (max 200): summary, start, end | durationMinutes, allDay, timezone, description, location, url, uid, rrule, exdates, alarms (minutes before), organizer {name,email}, attendees [{name,email,role,rsvp}], status, categories, geo {lat,lon}, transparent, sequence, priority, class

timezone.description: IANA time zone for events without their own (e.g. Europe/Berlin)
